name: home1
js: const c=__bw.ctl, T=__bw.THREE; const camp=__bw.scene.getObjectByName('attackerCamp'); if(!camp) return {camp:false}; const bb=new T.Box3(); camp.traverse(o=>{ if(o.isMesh){ const b=new T.Box3().setFromObject(o); if(isFinite(b.min.x)) bb.union(b);} }); const ct=bb.getCenter(new T.Vector3()); c.target.x=ct.x; c.target.z=ct.z; c.dist=110; return {camp:true,vis:camp.visible,c:[ct.x|0,ct.z|0],size:bb.getSize(new T.Vector3()).toArray().map(v=>v|0), kids:camp.children.length, n:camp.children[0]&&camp.children[0].count};
